title: 第八章：我们再来一圈
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

好在的是两个世界的时间差，地球这边才过去十几天，而他回到地球后把那些小叶紫檀木料让加工厂加工好，再把木料让唐明军过来拉回去盖房子去。当初就有让亮子他们砍了很多，当那加工厂老板见到这上好的木料时眼都直了。

“苏先生，我们也算是老熟人了，你就匀一些木料给我吧！我以市场价高出百分之二十的价格收购一些”

“欧阳，你不是有一家家具加工厂吗？你就用这木料给我做一些家具吧！我也懒得再叫别人了”

因为上回他拿出来的樟树给欧阳老板加工，这老板就眼红的要死，但也刚认识也不怎么好开口，之后他主动联系了他，两人关系也算还可以，现在看到这木料时，他厚着脸皮也要拿下一些。

“做家具啊！那感情好啊，不说全国，就这省内我们厂可以说第二，就没人敢说第一”

“那好吧，等一下我一个朋友会过来，正好他帮我盖房子，要怎么做你和他商量一下，我的要求就是你们配合好就行，不要搞的不伦不类的就可以。”

没过一会，唐明军过来了，当他看到这木料时就大骂：

“行枫，你真是败家啊，用这上好的木料来盖房子！你那批樟木我就不说你了，但是你知道这小叶紫檀多贵吗？而且还这么大的料，你那房子要真用这盖起来，你房子那还不成天价了啊？”

他之所以会用这个，是因为他也有了解，要不然他也不让亮子去砍这么多了啊！

“有钱，任性，怎么地？哈哈！我也想当一回大土豪，不可以啊！”

他走上去拍了拍唐明军的肩膀，大声说道。

“我.....你有钱，你是大佬，要不你收我当小弟呗！我想当土豪的朋友！呵呵！”

唐明军双手拉住他的手握着，可怜兮兮双眼还不停的嫖着他。

“放手，我可不好那口，起开啦！”

他不客气的把唐明军踢到一边。

在唐明军的计算下，把之前樟木全替换掉，然后算好留下的小叶紫檀木料，剩下的匀了一些欧阳老板，再弄了些做家具的，其他全部唐明军收购了。

以唐明军的原话是‘自家兄弟，你不给我，我跟你急’。

更过分的是这家伙还说：

“这阵子没钱，等有钱再把钱给你，就当是兄弟借的吧！诺！这是欠条。”

边说还边在一边拿出一张纸写上一张借条，还有板有眼的。苏行枫接过那张借条，看也没看就撕了，以他现在有戒子这么逆天的功能要钱还不容易啊！

没钱了再叫亮子他们再去砍就是了，自己手上现在还不是还有很多药材嘛！更有的是还有上千年份的人参都还没出手呢！

仓库一下就被清空了，等唐明军和欧阳走后，他又把那些药材拿出来，打了个电话同仁堂的杨老，让他带人来收购。

虽然这些药材不是很特殊，但是价格高啊！现在一下拿出这么多，量也大，更重要的是这些药材的药用价值比普通的高，价格这是要翻翻啊！

和他自己想的一样，杨老带着黄老一起来的，同来的还有上回接待他的那个小妹和另外一些工作人员。

杨老两师兄弟见到这些东西时更是说不出话来，在那叫嚷着工作人员拿设备仔细鉴定着。像杨老他们这种研究狂一但开始工作时，什么事也理不上的，索性他还是搬出桌椅坐在仓库门口，泡着茶等着他们。

直到天黑，他把仓库里的灯全

“小苏啊！你这批的药材真得是极品啊！特别是那紫灵芝没得说，可以说是真正的仙草都不为过啊！那药效真的是可以把死人救回来啊！”

黄老一副兴奋劲的神情，但是还掩饰不了他那个疲惫身躯。

他让两老坐下，给他们倒上茶水，让他们好好休息一下，这忙就是一天，这老头的身体还是很难吃的消的。

“两位老师傅，你们也看到了，这些东西都是刚采下来没多久，还都很新鲜呢，我也不懂怎么去晒制，要是弄得不好，弄坏了就不好了，所以我朋友都是通过航运运回来的。这不，第一时间就通知你们过来嘛！”

“小苏说的没错，东西再好也要制作，就比如那石斛一样，这么好的材料当然要配上顶尖的师傅制作才能达到最好的药效。”

“杨师傅，黄师傅，我们统计出来了，计算好了价格，一共是2455万。”

这时一个中年女子拿出一个平板电脑，来到杨老边上慢慢的把这些数据报了出来。而杨老和黄老在那看了一会才点点头：

“嗯，小苏啊，这个价格可是我们以溢价百分之三的收购价哦！不知道你是否满意？”

“满，满意，我相信杨老不会坑我的，哈哈！”

这个时候的他哪还会去听杨老说什么，当他听到那中年女子报出的价格时自己也吓了一跳。

‘我去，我这就成了千万富翁了啊！！！’，心里早点飞到哪去了啊？

这也不能怪他，他从小就穷，哪见过这么多钱啊！上回卖的蛇皮没过一天就花得差不多了。更主要的是那中年女子念出这价格时一字一句的说，很是慢，就好像是支付宝上那到账信息一样，让他听得都入迷了。

“那行，还是上回那个卡号吧？”

“是的，还是那张卡。”

“那就好。还好的是我们三个都来了，要不然这次交易，还真没这么快.....”

杨老解释一翻才知道，他和黄老两个人交易额度一个人最高一千万，再加上这个女经理五百万，要不然就要通过上面申请了，这一趟下来也要一天时间，他们等得了时间，可是这药材这样放着，多一天就药效少一点啊！

在三个人共同操作下，把这帐结了，过了十多分钟，他的手机传来2555万到账信息。双方确认无误后，杨老他们又马不停蹄的又叫来保鲜大货车，亲自监督把货装完，而苏行枫没在那等，他只让他们装完货后把锁带上就行。

他打了个的回到出租屋里休息，第二天他来汽车城，因为他发现没有车真的是很不方便，所以现在有钱了，他也要阔一下，怎么说现在咱也是千万富翁不是？

汽车城内，一家悍马4S店内。

他直劲走向展台上一辆全黑色的悍马车，那是今天刚出的民用版悍马H1，今年六月份的。以前他开过军用的版的，自己超喜欢，各项性能都很不错，所以他进店后没有叫服务员给自己介绍。

他刚来到车旁，一个年青男子，就从他后面快速的走向那车。

“哇！好家伙啊，我这都等它一年了啊！哈哈！”

Page (1/3)

Fortunately, there was a time difference between the two worlds. It had only been more than ten days on the earth. After he returned to the earth, he had the small-leaf rosewood wood processed by the processing factory, and then asked Tang Mingjun to bring the wood back to build a house.Liangzi and the others had been asked to cut a lot of them at the beginning. When the owner of the processing plant saw the fine wood, his eyes went straight.

"Mr. Su, we are old acquaintances, please give me some wood! I will buy some at a price that is 20% higher than the market price."

"Ouyang, don't you have a furniture processing factory? Just use this wood to make some furniture for me! I'm too lazy to call anyone else."

Because the camphor tree he took out last time was processed by Boss Ouyang, the boss was jealous to death, but he didn't find it easy to talk to him after they had just met. After that, he took the initiative to contact him, and the relationship between the two was not bad. Now when he saw this wood, he had the shamelessness to take some.

"Making furniture! It's such a good feeling. Not only in the whole country, but in this province, our factory can be ranked second, but no one dares to be ranked first."

"Well, a friend of mine will come over later, and he happens to be helping me build a house. You can discuss with him what to do. All I ask is that you cooperate well, and don't do anything inappropriate."

After a while, Tang Mingjun came over. When he saw the wood, he cursed:

"Xing Feng, you are such a prodigal, using this good wood to build a house! I won't talk about your batch of camphor wood, but do you know how expensive this small-leaf red sandalwood is? And it is such a large material. If your house is really built with this, your house will not be worth a sky-high price, right?"

The reason why he uses this is because he also understands it, otherwise he wouldn't let Ryoko chop so many!

"Rich and willful, what the hell? Haha! I also want to be a rich man, but I can't!"

He walked up and patted Tang Mingjun on the shoulder and said loudly.

"I...you are rich and you are a boss, how about you accept me as your younger brother! I want to be a friend of the rich! Haha!"

Tang Mingjun took his hand and held it with both hands, his pitiful eyes still looking at him.

"Let go, I don't want to say that, let's go!"

He kicked Tang Mingjun aside rudely.

Under Tang Mingjun's calculations, all the previous camphor wood was replaced, and then the remaining small-leaf rosewood wood was calculated. The rest was mixed with some boss Ouyang, and some for furniture making, and Tang Mingjun bought the rest.

According to Tang Mingjun's original words, "Brother, if you don't give it to me, I will be in trouble with you."

What's even more outrageous is that this guy also said:

"I don't have any money right now. When I have money, I will give it to you. Just treat it as a loan from my brother! No! This is an IOU."

While talking, he took out a piece of paper and wrote an IOU, and he was very formal.Su Xingfeng took the IOU and tore it up without even looking at it. It's not easy for him to ask for money now that he has such an incredible power as a ring!

If you run out of money, just ask Liangzi and the others to cut it. Don’t you still have a lot of medicinal materials on hand?What’s more, there are thousands of years of ginseng that haven’t been sold yet!

The warehouse was emptied immediately. After Tang Mingjun and Ouyang left, he took out the medicinal materials and called Mr. Yang from Tongrentang and asked him to bring someone to buy them.

Although these medicinal materials are not very special, they are expensive!Now I can take out so much at once, and the quantity is large. More importantly, the medicinal value of these medicinal materials is higher than ordinary ones, and the price will go up!

Just as he thought, Mr. Yang came with Mr. Huang, along with the little girl who received him last time and some other staff members.

When brothers Yang and Lao saw these things, they were even speechless. They shouted at the staff to get the equipment and examine it carefully.Research freaks like Mr. Yang and the others couldn't take care of anything once they started working, so he simply moved out his desk and chairs and sat at the door of the warehouse, making tea and waiting for them.

Until it got dark, he turned on all the lights in the warehouse

"Xiao Su! This batch of medicinal materials of yours is really the best! Especially the purple Ganoderma lucidum, it can be said to be a real fairy grass! The effect of the medicine can really bring the dead back!"

Mr. Huang looked excited, but he could not hide his tired body.

He asked the two old men to sit down, poured them tea, and asked them to have a good rest. It had been a busy day, and it was still difficult for the old man's body to handle the food.

"Two masters, you have also seen that these things have just been picked not long ago, and they are still very fresh. I don't know how to dry them. If they are not done well, it will be bad if they are damaged, so my friends all bring them back by shipping. No, I will notify you as soon as possible!"

"Xiao Su is right, no matter how good something is, it must be made, just like the dendrobium. Of course, such good materials must be produced by top masters to achieve the best medicinal effect."

"Master Yang, Master Huang, we have made statistics and calculated the price. The total is 24.55 million."

At this time, a middle-aged woman took out a tablet computer, came to Mr. Yang and slowly reported the data.Mr. Yang and Mr. Huang looked there for a while before nodding:

"Well, Xiao Su, this price is our purchase price with a premium of 3%! I wonder if you are satisfied?"

"Man, satisfied, I believe Mr. Yang will not cheat me, haha!"

At this time, he couldn't listen to what Mr. Yang had to say. He was shocked when he heard the price quoted by the middle-aged woman.

‘Here I go, I’ll become a multi-millionaire!!!’, where did your heart fly to earlier?

You can't blame him for this. He has been poor since he was a child, and he has never seen so much money!The snake skins sold last time were almost spent within a day.What's more important is that when the middle-aged woman read out the price, she said it word by word, very slowly, just like the payment information on Alipay, which made him fascinated.

"Okay, let's keep the same card number as last time, right?"

"Yes, it's still the same card."

"That's good. Fortunately, the three of us are here, otherwise this transaction would not be so fast..."

After explaining it, Mr. Yang found out that he and Mr. Huang had a maximum transaction limit of 10 million each, plus 5 million for the female manager. Otherwise, they would have to apply through the above. This trip would take a day. They had time to wait, but if the medicinal materials were kept like this, the effect would be less if it was left for another day!

With the joint operation of three people, the account was settled. More than ten minutes later, information about the arrival of 25.55 million was sent to his mobile phone.After both parties confirmed that everything was correct, Mr. Yang and the others called for the large fresh-keeping truck without stopping and personally supervised the loading of the goods. However, Su Xingfeng did not wait there. He only asked them to lock the goods after loading.

He took a taxi and went back to the rental house to rest. The next day he came to Auto City because he found that it was really inconvenient not to have a car, so now that he has money, he also wants to be richer. After all, we are also multi-millionaires now, aren't we?

In the Auto City, there is a Hummer 4S store.

He walked straight towards an all-black Hummer on the stand. It was the civilian version of the Hummer H1 that was just released today in June this year.He had driven the military version before and he liked it very much. All the functions were very good, so he didn't ask the waiter to introduce it to him after entering the store.

As soon as he came to the car, a young man quickly walked towards the car from behind.

"Wow! What a guy, I've been waiting for this for a year! Haha!"
